quote: From the beginning, Albania Travel made the planning process easy and removed any apprehension we had about travelling in a completely new country. Every detail was carefully tailored to our needs, and through their local partner Wander Albania, everything from accommodation to transport was organised seamlessly. What stood out most was Ermal, who became much more than a driver. Our trip exceeded expectations and was one of the best travel experiences we have had in decades of travelling.

The most impressive part of planning the trip was the care and attention put into the creating of our itinerary by the Albania Travel team at the planning stage. Our every wish was catered for, and our Albanian driver/guide could not have been more helpful in meeting our requests on a daily basis. A truly professional and dedicated team in Australia and Albania, working together for the benefit of their clients.

Our trips with Ylli were informative, safe and well-paced, with great coffee breaks to break up the journeys. Berat Castle was another highlight, with beautiful accommodation and plenty of time to explore. The tour suited our slower pace, and we never felt rushed. Albania is still developing its tourism, but the people are so proud, friendly and eager to share their culture.

The tour covered north, south, east and west and was a perfect blend of history, culture and offering a deep dive into Albania's heritage and stunning mountain landscapes. Our tour guide, Ladi was very knowledgeable, funny, and incredibly passionate about his country. Albania exceeded our expectations this time. It's affordable, not crowded and packed with beauty.

Albania is a fascinating country with a colourful history and beautiful scenery. Tirana is a must, Shkoder is lively and fun, and the mountain visit was beautiful. All of the hotels were very good, especially the castle stay in Berat. I really can't say enough how kind and helpful Ermal was. The care and support were first class.
